case_rationale_audits.rationale_assessment: Follows pooling into partitioning and both retained fractions; the expanded visible context supports the additional UMI, ERCC and MPO claims.
case_rationale_audits.rationale_text: The graph explicitly connects separate-well products through water addition, pooling of differently cell-barcoded wells and oil removal to the pooled product, then through a partition operation to both retained fractions. The context reports second-strand synthesis before pooling, shared cell barcodes, 0.7x SPRI binding of endogenous cDNA and transfer of the spatial-barcode supernatant, with IVT/library preparation for the endogenous route. PHO/MPO intrinsic UMIs and the capture-primer UMI are described separately. ERCC RNA is added before reverse transcription and second-strand synthesis, supporting its inclusion among the RNA-derived products; pooling and partition do not report removal of the retained barcode identities. These premises support the stated interfaces and all required material handoffs.

The resulting 7 μL is then used in the second PCR, establishing an unsampled remainder by the reported volumes. The passage describes no subsequent production use of that remainder. The value preserves this reporting limit without claiming that the remainder was discarded or never used.

case_rationale_audits.rationale_assessment: Identifies the absent partition Operation and material Flows. It rejects disconnected State names as sufficient coverage without inferring physical nonexistence of partitioning.
case_rationale_audits.rationale_text: The pooling operation and its input/output flows represent the pooling portion reported in the context. However, the graph has no operation consuming the pooled product to perform the first SPRI partition and no output flows producing the transferred spatial supernatant and retained bead-bound cDNA. Those fraction States alone do not represent the required transformation and handoffs. The source reports the partition, but the incomplete graph does not claim that it was physically absent, so the coverage failure is not an experimental contradiction.
case_rationale_audits.unsupported_clause: The coverage assertion is unmet: the first SPRI partition operation and the material handoffs from the pooled product to the spatial-barcode supernatant and bead-bound endogenous cDNA are missing.

summary.input_separation_status: Whitelist plus recorded access audit; not filesystem isolation.
summary.comparison_conclusion: Both configurations pass these same small controls. This provides no evidence that the longer field-accountable prompt is superior.

operational_observations: Both attempts recovered from two sandbox namespace-start failures. Command lines retained workspace-write sandbox and managed approval settings; this audit does not reconstruct every approval decision.

Both attempted Unicode-containing scripts with system python and encountered Python 2 syntax failures, then switched to python3. Basic review also encountered unavailable jsonschema and used local manual validation; host model validation succeeded.

Both read /etc/agents/AGENTS.md before a successful hostname/SLURM location check, contrary to that document’s stated ordering. This is operational noncompliance; no scientific evidence or label exposure follows from it.
No outer session retry, data repair or label adjustment occurred during this audit. In-turn command recovery occurred and remains in the traces.
limits: Four manually selected, model-authored, source-audited pairs are regression sentinels, not expert gold or a statistical accuracy estimate.
The omission requirement is explicitly supplied; this does not test autonomous discovery of every missing paper requirement.
Paired values share contexts and are easier than whole-graph production review. Distinct native threads do not establish independent scientific judges or model diversity.
No recorded forbidden read was found. Input whitelisting and CLI event audit do not establish OS-enforced secrecy or prove absence of all unrecorded channels.

The original remote prepared cases/labels and every original source file were not recopied into these 27 files. This audit reconstructs visible case values/source text from the pinned local Workflow, exact packet and audited definitions, rather than claiming a fresh remote-filesystem pin check.
Eight controls per configuration do not establish whole-graph completeness, production-review sensitivity, biochemical compatibility, execution readiness or experimental validity.
Elapsed times include operational recovery. Cumulative native tokens are not a single context size.
No prompts, labels, controls or outputs were tuned after observing these scores.
